description: This file defines the configuration properties class 'AuthenticationServerClientConfigProperties' for the 'DelegatingAuthenticationService', extending 'ClientConfigProperties' and including a property for signature validation, used in the authentication service within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerClientConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for the Delegating Authentication Service, extending ClientConfigProperties with an additional SignatureSupportingConfigProperties for validation.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSupportingConfigProperties instance used for key material validation in user token verification.
